item.title: 58 Middleware Modules at 400ns
item.description: The architecture behind Stockyard's middleware chain. Function composition, zero-alloc toggle registry, and why Go closures are the right primitive for LLM proxying.

item.title: Why One Binary: Building an LLM Gateway with Go and SQLite
item.description: Why I chose Go over Python and SQLite over Postgres for an LLM proxy. The engineering tradeoffs behind shipping sixteen apps as one static binary.

item.title: Replacing 134 LLM Tools with One Binary
item.description: The LLM middleware ecosystem is fragmented across 134+ standalone tools. Here's how Stockyard consolidates them into a single Go binary.

item.title: Architecture Decisions Behind Stockyard
item.description: Why Go, why SQLite, why a single binary, and why 66 middleware modules instead of a plugin system.

item.title: Why I Built Stockyard
item.description: I was building an app with the OpenAI API. Then I shipped it. Within the first week, three things went wrong.
